描述_EN: the top line is edged with buttonhole stitches in twisted magenta yarn, arranged closely together, with flat gilt-paper strips woven in and out of these foundation stitches to form a basket-work pattern. children's shoes were often used to showcase a multitude of embroidery techniques. for this pair, untwisted floss silks worked in satin stitches have been used to depict floral scrolls on the yellow satin uppers. this decorative technique, known as overlock embroidery (suo bian xiu), was frequently used to finish the raw edges of purses or shoe uppers. the toe caps in brown velvet are embroidered with couched gold-wrapped threads and knot stitches, resembling a butterfly with flowers beneath its wings.
描述_ZN: 顶线用扭曲的洋红色纱线的扣眼线镶边，紧密地排列在一起，扁平的鎏金纸条在这些基础针线中交织，形成一个篮子的图案。 儿童的鞋子经常被用来展示大量的刺绣技术。 在这双鞋中，用缎子缝制的无捻线丝绸被用来描绘黄色缎子鞋面上的花纹。 这种装饰技术被称为包边绣（suo bian xiu），经常被用来完成皮包或鞋面的原始边缘。 棕色天鹅绒的脚趾盖用金丝线和结针绣出，就像一只翅膀下有花的蝴蝶。
